name: ptolemy
description: macOS menu bar command palette with plugin-based search and an embedded Claude chat, built with Electrobun, React, and Tailwind CSS

scripts.build:native: clang -dynamiclib -framework AppKit -framework Carbon -fobjc-arc -o src/bun/native/liboverlay.dylib src/bun/native/overlay.m -arch arm64
scripts.start: bun run build:native && bun run build:vite && electrobun dev
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && bun run build:vite && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.dev:hmr: bun run build:native && concurrently "NODE_ENV=development vite build --watch --mode development" "NODE_ENV=development vite build --config vite.chat.config.ts --watch --mode development" "electrobun dev --watch"
scripts.build:canary: bun run build:native && bun run build:vite && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:release: bun run build:native && bun run build:vite && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:dev-bundle: bun run build:native && bun run build:vite && bunx electrobun build --env=dev
scripts.screenshots: bun run build:dev-bundle && vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts
scripts.build:site: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.appium:install-driver: appium driver list --installed 2>&1 | grep -q mac2 || appium driver install mac2
